identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of BL-B01D1+TKI±Pembrolizumab in Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Renal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of BL-B01D1 in Combination With Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitor (TKI) With or Without Pembrolizumab (BL-B01D1+TKI±Pembrolizumab) in Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Renal Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This Phase II study is a clinical study to explore the efficacy and safety of BL-B01D1 in combination with tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) with or without pembrolizumab (BL-B01D1+TKI±Pembrolizumab) in patients with locally advanced or metastatic renal cancer.

armGroups.label: BL-B01D1+TKI±Pembrolizumab
armGroups.description: Participants receive BL-B01D1+TKI±Pembrolizumab in the first cycle (3 weeks). Participants with clinical benefit could receive additional treatment for more cycles. The administration will be terminated because of disease progression or intolerable toxicity occurring or other reasons.

interventions.name: BL-B01D1
interventions.description: Administration by intravenous infusion for a cycle of 3 weeks.

interventions.name: Axitinib
interventions.description: Oral administration, and twice daily with an interval of 12 hours.

interventions.name: Pembrolizumab
interventions.description: Administration by intravenous infusion for a cycle of 3 weeks.

primaryOutcomes.description: Objective response rate (ORR) is defined as the number of CR and PR in the treatment and control groups divided by the number of that group in the full analysis set (FAS).

The RP2D is defined as the dose level chosen by the sponsor (in consultation with the investigators) for phase II study, based on safety, tolerability, efficacy, PK, and PD data collected during the dose escalation study of BL-B01D1.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Frequency of Treatment Emergent Adverse Event (TEAE)
primaryOutcomes.description: Frequency of TEAE will be investigated. TEAE is defined as any unfavorable and unintended change in the structure, function, or chemistry of the body temporally emerging, or any worsening (i.e., any clinically significant adverse change in frequency and/or intensity) of a pre-existing condition during the treatment of BL-B01D1. The type, frequency and severity of TEAE will be evaluated during the treatment of BL-B01D1.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Progression-free survival (PFS) as assessed by BICR is defined as the time between the date subjects are randomized and the first observation of disease progression (based on BICR's image-based assessment) or death.

Disease Control Rate (DCR) : Percentage of all randomized subjects who rated the best overall response (BOR) as complete response (CR), partial response (PR), and disease stabilization (SD) according to RECIST 1.1 criteria.
Duration of Response (DOR) : defined as the period from the date when tumor response is first recorded to the date when objective tumor progression is first recorded or the date of death.
Overall survival (OS) is defined as the time between the subject's randomization date and subject's death.
Maximum serum concentration (Cmax) will be investigated.
Time to maximum serum concentration (Tmax) will be investigated.
Ctrough is defined as the lowest serum concentration of BL-B01D1 prior to the next dose will be administered.
Frequency of anti-BL-B01D1 antibody (ADA) will be investigated.
